segments.name: Electric vehicles
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells electric vehicles, powertrains and battery systems to consumers through its own retail network and online channels.
segments.evidence: Lucid designed, developed, manufactures and sells two groundbreaking EVs: The Lucid Air sedan, for which customer deliveries began in late 2021, and the Lucid Gravity SUV, which arrived on the road in late 2024.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and third parties pay the company for vehicles and related services, and for licensing of EV platforms, powertrains, battery technology and software.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell vehicles directly to consumers through our retail sales network and online channels, including Lucid Financial Services.
